name: EdLib
description: Jens-Christian Huus's AdLib music editor, version 1.05a, with 27 example songs
author: Jens-Christian Huus

start.note: DosKit closes its About box. Ctrl+F3 lists the songs, Enter loads one, F3 plays it.

hint: EdLib opens with an About box: press Escape to close it; then Ctrl+F3 lists the example songs, Enter loads one and F3 plays it.
